# University of Gloucestershire Research Repository

> An institutional research repository and digital archive showcasing academic research, creative practice, and scholarly outputs from the University of Gloucestershire.

The Research Repository serves as an open-access platform for disseminating peer-reviewed research, theses, and creative works from University of Gloucestershire faculty and students. It supports discovery and access to institutional research outputs across multiple disciplines including art, design, business, and academic research.

## Browse & Discover

- [Welcome to the Research Repository](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk): Homepage for University of Gloucestershire Research Repository
- [Browse by Division and Year](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/view/divisions): Browse research by academic divisions and organizational structure
- [Browse by Research Priority Area and Year](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/view/rpa): Browse research by priority areas including creative practice and applied business
- [Browse by Subject](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/view/subjects): Browse repository contents by Library of Congress subject classification
- [Browse by Year](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/view/year): Browse research repository contents by publication year chronologically
- [Browse by Journal or Publication Title](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/view/journals): Browse research by journal and publication titles in the repository
- [Browse by Thesis Advisor](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/view/thesis_advisors): Browse postgraduate theses by thesis advisor directory

## Art & Creative Practice

- [Matthew Murray Finalist in The International Street Photography Awards 2012](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/4618): Street photography finalist work by Matthew Murray from 2012 awards
- [Above the line Advertising Campaign for Eon - FA Cup](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/4688): Advertising campaign creative work for Eon FA Cup by TBWA London
- [The Digital Bouquet](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/3385): Digital artwork and photography exhibition project by Clancy and Saklani
- [Borders](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/4401): Art exhibition featuring work by Davison, Geddes, and Salkeld
- [Albert Irvin and Abstract Expressionism](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/6958): Exhibition catalogue on Albert Irvin and abstract expressionism art history
- [Structures / Strukturen British and German Painting in Dialogue](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/2644): British and German painting dialogue exhibition by Bick at international galleries
- [Solo show, Handrailing, New Art Centre, Roche Court Sculpture Park](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/14785): Solo art exhibition by Olivia Bax at New Art Centre Roche Court
- [Saddleworth: Responding To A Landscape - Exhibition Elliott Halls Gallery, Amsterdam](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/6369): Landscape photography exhibition by Murray at Elliott Halls Gallery Amsterdam
- [Upsom Downs](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/3092): Painting exhibition by Katie Pratt at Galerie Peter Zimmermann

## Community & Cultural Projects

- ["An evening of..." series of three public cultural history lectures each on a Forest of Dean author](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/6127): Public cultural history lectures on Forest of Dean authors including Winifred Foley
- [Forest Writers Mural Project](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/6249): Community mural project celebrating Forest of Dean writers
- [The Assessment, Design, and Planning of Small Public Spaces in Urban Areas](https://eprints.glos.ac.uk/6677): Urban planning conference lecture on public space design and assessment
